name: bugfix_wargear_material
description: Logic bug fix: wargear material slots are misassigned. Redirects the StaticMesh Materials slots that point to WorldGridMaterial (the engine's gray-grid fallback material) to each weapon's own MI_*_Lo on the grav gun, flamer, and hand flamer. Equal-length in-place byte edit; file sizes and internal offsets are unchanged.
source: Clean Steam baseline, Build 1837603 (edited in place; no assets from refs/PC_EE are referenced).
grading: L0: equal length, only the target slots changed, and ue4prop readback of the slots correct; L1: assets fully re-readable by the same parser. L2/L3 in-game not verified. Confirmed byte-level differences with an explainable root cause; high-confidence inference that the gray-grid material is the WorldGridMaterial fallback.
install_note: Overwrite the game file at the matching relative_path (back up the original first). To roll back, verify the original against the manifest's src_sha256 and restore it.
